content: We thank Halil Kilicoglu (NLM/NIH) for his help with the crawling and the manual evaluation and Sonya E. Shooshan (NLM/NIH) for her help with the judgment of the retrieved answers. We also thank Ellen Voorhees (NIST) for her valuable support with the TREC LiveQA evaluation.
